seoTitle: eBay Refund Guide: Get Your Money Back
metaDescription: Learn how to request a refund on eBay when an item didn't arrive, was damaged, or wasn't as described, and how to escalate an unresolved case.
intro: If an eBay order didn't arrive, was damaged, or wasn't as described, buyer protection can help you get your money back. This guide walks through starting a return or item-not-received case, communicating with the seller, and escalating to eBay support if needed.

steps.heading: Go to your Purchase History
steps.body: Open Purchase History and select the specific order you want to file a refund request for.

steps.heading: Start the Return or Item Not Received process
steps.body: Choose the option that matches your situation, whether the item never arrived or wasn't as described.

steps.heading: Add photos and a clear explanation
steps.body: Provide supporting photos and a clear description of the issue to strengthen your case.

steps.heading: Communicate through eBay's messaging system
steps.body: Message the seller directly within eBay's system, which keeps your communication documented under buyer protection rules.

steps.heading: Escalate to eBay support if needed
steps.body: If the seller ignores or denies your request, you can escalate the case to eBay support within the applicable time frame.

steps.heading: Track your refund
steps.body: Once resolved, monitor your PayPal or bank account status to confirm the refund has been processed.

faq.question: What if my eBay item never arrived?
faq.answer: You can open an Item Not Received case from your Purchase History, which starts the refund process under buyer protection.

faq.question: What if the seller denies my refund request?
faq.answer: If the seller denies or ignores your request, you can escalate the case to eBay support for review.

faq.question: Do I need photos to request a refund?
faq.answer: Photos strengthen your case, especially for damaged, fake, or not-as-described items, so it's recommended to include them.

faq.question: How long do I have to file a refund request?
faq.answer: eBay applies specific time frames for filing and escalating refund cases, so it's best to act as soon as an issue is noticed.

faq.question: How can I check if my refund was processed?
faq.answer: You can track your refund status through your PayPal or bank account, depending on how the original payment was made.
